question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

FOX ? JSX LUX NWX
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (+2) is added to each position value according to English alphabetic series.

So, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10d188a33813719429fcdaddacd0b01e672004a4d2c5287864a77a6bf427de9a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "HQX".
